Password Hashing with bcrypt

The password column stops being a placeholder — every password this project stores from here on is a bcrypt hash.

  • Why Plaintext Passwords Are a Liability

    Laravel's Hash facade did this for you automatically. Node doesn't — so it's finally worth seeing done by hand.

  • Hashing and Verifying with bcrypt

    One function to hash a password on write, one to check a guess against that hash on login — never the reverse.

  • Hashing the Seed Data Too

    The seed script's placeholder passwords become real hashes, using the exact same function register uses.
